_meta.source: raw Redfish captures: GET /redfish/v1/Systems/System.Embedded.1/Bios/BiosRegistry (registry) + GET .../Bios (exposed attributes). See captures[]

field_notes.read_only/hidden/immutable/write_only/re: maps per capture. Dell registry flags are STATE-DEPENDENT (evaluated from Dependencies against current values, e.g. SysProfile!=Custom makes many perf attributes ReadOnly); not a static property
field_notes.default: Dell BiosAttributeRegistry has no DefaultValue; null unless HelpText states "Default: <value>" verbatim (default_source)
field_notes.exposed_in_bios_resource: true = attribute appears in GET .../Bios Attributes on that model (registry may contain hidden/model-absent entries)
field_notes.sample_value: current value on the captured machine (NOT a default)
field_notes.variants: per-capture differences of type/allowed values/flags vs first capture
